description.value: The Riptide Marine Pub is a casual oceanside pub and restaurant in Campbell River situated along the Island Highway with sweeping ocean and mountain views from both its charming interior and an outdoor patio. The kitchen emphasizes local, seasonal, and organic ingredients, with a seafood-forward menu featuring local oysters, halibut, and wild BC salmon. The pub also hosts live music and maintains a community-minded atmosphere, making it a welcoming full-service stop for touring cyclists.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides authoritative contact details (1340 Island Hwy, Campbell River BC; 250-830-0044) and confirms the business is actively open as a marine pub/restaurant with a food menu updated April 2026. OSM supplied only name='Riptide' and amenity=pub; the website consistently uses the fuller name 'The Riptide Marine Pub' across all pages, flagged as a discrepancy. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those fields are null; the food menu does explicitly list a gluten-free roll add-on option and the site states dietary accommodations are available on request.
